title: NorthernCompassRevived
description: The official NorthernCompass hasn't received updates in 2 years. We are sustaining a revived version with new fixes here.
body:
# Fork of NorthernCompass
NorthernCompass changes the functionality of the Compass from showing your spawn location to showing to north. I love that, but I got an incompatibility in my ModPack Alyrion, with the Mod Quark. I then looked at the GitHub repo and saw it was not maintained since 2 years and there were multiple unmoderated issues.

We grabbed the mod, fixed the Quark incompatibility and are now maintining the mod.

---

The official NorthernCompass hasn't received updates in 2 years. We are sustaining a revived version with new fixes here.

Features:
Compass always shows the north.
Compability with Quark.
